title: Anchorage Helicopter Flightseeing Tour (30 min)
blurb: Get a rare view of Alaska’s beauty on a 30-minute trip into the heart of glacier country. You'll see vast ice-fields and glaciers as you glide past the jagged peaks of the Chugach mountains. Keep your camera ready for a chance to spot wildlife including moose, black and brown bear, Dall sheep and mountain goats.
